description: This file defines classes and enums related to Bluetooth AVDTP (Audio/Video Distribution Transport Protocol) stream endpoints, including data structures, client/server interfaces, and service categories for Bluetooth audio streaming.

classes.name: StreamEndPointData
classes.description: Represents Bluetooth AVDTP stream endpoint data, including capabilities, configuration, and state management.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service category within a stream endpoint, with validation and string representation methods.

classes.name: StreamEndPoint
classes.description: Derived class that combines data and control interface for a Bluetooth AVDTP stream endpoint.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth AVDTP client operations such as discovery, configuration, and signaling commands.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Abstract base class for Bluetooth AVDTP server, handling incoming signals and managing stream endpoints.

classes.name: IStreamEndPointControl
classes.description: Interface for controlling stream endpoint actions like start, suspend, open, close, abort, and security.

methods.name: SetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for a stream endpoint.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration of a remote stream endpoint.
